description:
Wakasa-sensei and Okiya chaperone Conan and the Detective Boys to a beach in Shizuoka that is running a collab with Kamen Yaiba, where they get involved in a murder case. Three beach hut employees are suspected of killing their manager Usui. Koriyama is under most scrutiny, as he was found sleeping next to the body, but Conan senses something is off about his unnatural fatigue.
Source: crunchyroll

titles.title: The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders (Part 2)
